quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation.condition: A motor vehicle is on a curve or on the approach to or near a grade crest.

obligation.description: Turn to proceed in the opposite direction under the stated visibility condition.

timing.description: Evaluate location and visibility throughout the observed turn episode.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Review generated plan-view curvature and the complete physical reversal interval.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review generated grade profile, crest station and original vehicle-body location during the reversal.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review the complete original forward-reverse-forward path and final travel heading, not a controller request alone.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet
judgment_calls_needed.note: Keep both roadway directions, actual 500-foot road distance, original body rays and pixel review distinct; an analytic centerline ray alone does not establish recognition.

parameter_refs.name: turn_to_opposite_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: full original heading and signed-motion episode; unknown until captured

parameter_refs.name: curve_or_crest_geometry
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: generated OpenDRIVE curvature and grade readback, including curve and crest alternatives

parameter_refs.name: two_direction_500ft_visibility
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: both original roadway approaches, body rays, pixel review and observer positions at statutory roadway distance
